spanish: Bandera de campamento de Dan tsafónah a sus ejércitos; y príncipe a hijos de Dan, Ajiezer hijo de Amishadai.

findings.issue: Common noun צָפֹנָה (north, with directional suffix) is left untranslated as tsafónah.

notes: Dan, Ajiezer, and Amishadai are proper names; Dan is the locked Spanish form.
